summary.cause: MarkdownBody's block painter (packages/dispatch/web/src/features/refs/MarkdownBody.tsx paintBlock) serializes task items with Milkdown's toDOM, which writes li[data-item-type=task][data-checked] and no box; styles.css draws nothing for it, so prose shows the same disc bullet for ticked and unticked items. Probed at 7f7edb8d with bun test + happy-dom: no input element.
change:
New packages/dispatch/web/src/features/refs/task-checkboxes.ts: drawTaskCheckboxes(root) inserts (checked attribute and property set from data-checked) as the first child of each task item's first

.

MarkdownBody.tsx paintBlock calls drawTaskCheckboxes(element) after replaceChildren and before the tight-list unwrap (the unwrap condition still holds, so the box moves into the li with the text). Doc comment updated.

styles.css: one block under .dispatch-markdown: task li list-style none; the box sized in em, aligned to the first line, standing where the bullet stood, pointer-events none; same declarations under the ask-footer selector if the footer's (0,4,1) li rule wins any property.
packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md line 291: task items in the block variant draw a disabled checkbox; inline variant and MarkdownPreview draw no list and so no box.
decisions: Post-paint pass in paintBlock, not a serializer override: a node function cannot reach the child paragraph and ProseMirror refuses a content hole beside a sibling; a separate module keeps off the lines siblings INFRA-526/528/529 edit and also reaches task lists inside callouts.
Native disabled checkbox, no aria-label, own data attribute (never the editor's proof-task-checkbox class or data-task-checkbox, which the unlayered lib.css and Proof's plugin act on).
No bullet or number on a task item, as the document editor (lib.css:92-94); a plain item in the same list keeps its bullet.

Out of scope: the inline variant (paintInline) and MarkdownPreview (paintOneLine) serialize only textblock contents and draw no list at all, and sit inside buttons, links and labels where an input is invalid HTML.
